details.scheduledCleanup: The real EventBridge schedule started the cleanup Fargate task. It removed one expired uncommitted upload record and its exact S3 staging object. Committed artifacts and bytes remained readable.
details.migration: The Phase 11 image migrated an existing populated RDS catalog. The source integrity task passed after the integrity scanner was corrected to read each saved version's routing mode.
details.restore: The application was quiesced, an RDS snapshot and S3 object copy were restored into clean providers, 60 objects were verified, and the restored installation passed the normal integrity check.
details.destroy: Pulumi deleted all 73 managed resources and reports zero remaining stack resources. The versioned S3 bucket was emptied only after its qualification tags were verified. The encrypted qualification-only RDS final snapshot was verified, then deleted. AWS may retain inactive ECS task-definition revisions and Secrets Manager deletion tombstones; they cannot serve traffic or retain Artifact Server data.
